blinding_guess.why: The excerpt is a complete and self-consistent definition: all six packet fields are present with the types shown, and the md5 computes without error, so nothing inside it shows a break. Two things a consumer could trip on, though neither is a defect by itself: the numeric fields are std_msgs/Float32 wrapper messages (each carries a nested .data) rather than float32 primitives, and there is no Header, so no stamp or frame_id travels with the readings. Whether topic /imu is published at all, and with this type, is outside the excerpt, and a defect in the listed elements would only show against a consumer's expectation that I do not have.
